items.prompt: ___ matters at this level is reading the equation as a story.
items.hintAfterError: Na cleft sentence, a primeira parte funciona como 'aquilo que' e é o sujeito da frase.

items.prompt: What the equation ___ is how each competitor funds its growth.
What Company B ___ is borrow heavily to grow its asset base.
___ the P&L hides is the size of the deferred obligations.
What really worries me ___ how quickly the debt ___.
items.hintAfterError: Depois da oração com 'What…', o verbo de ligação vai no singular; 'the debt' também é singular.
